Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 21-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Embedded Systems [ECM_3122]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Differentiate between i) Microprocessor and Microcontroller. ii) RISC and CISC.                         (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Discuss the various hardware components in ARM based Embedded device with a neat diagram.               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Enlist any three commonly used Assembler directives in ARM along with their description.                (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Highlight the significance, features of PC relative addressing mode with suitable syntax or             (4)  
  examples.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Give the ARM data transfer instruction format indicating the function of each field.                    (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Differentiate the features of N flag and V flag with suitable examples.                                 (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Mention the instructions used in Processing of Arithmetic instructions. Discuss the procedure to        (4)  
  perform 64 bit addition.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Discuss the significance of Q-notation.Convert sqrt(3)/2 into a Q15 format.                             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Illustrate and explain Pipelining architecture in ARM.                                                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                Compare the looping statements used in ARM with examples.                                               (4)  
  
  
  Page #1

A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Extend the significance of Parameters in Subroutine by providing the example of Passing through       (3)  
  registers.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Discuss the fsalient features of ARM APCS                                                             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        What is an Exception? Elaborate on the significance of Vector table.                                  (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                List the operational quality attributes and define any two of them.                                   (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"

  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
